  Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
  Repeat
Notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

Color identity: B | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Cast all spells from your library and exile infinitely; Infinite damage; Infinite lifegain; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite storm count
Start: Mirror of Fate (battlefield); Aetherflux Reservoir (battlefield); Planar Void (battlefield); Gwenom, Remorseless (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Your life total is 16 or higher.
  Gwenom has attacked this turn.
Steps: Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and sacrificing it.
  Planar Void triggers, exiling Mirror of Fate from your graveyard.
  Resolve the Mirror of Fate ability, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
  Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Gwenom.
  Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
  Repeat.
Notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

Start: Blight Mound (battlefield); Bloodsoaked Champion (graveyard); Pitiless Plunderer (battlefield); Phantom Train (battlefield)

  Repeat.

Color identity: B | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 20 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite rummaging; Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite draw triggers; Infinite self-discard triggers; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Zombie Infestation (battlefield); Doom Weaver (battlefield); Carrion Feeder (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
Steps: Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
  When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Zombie.
  Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie.
  When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
  Repeat.

## Combo 1857-2178-4481
Cards: Thornbite Staff + Gift of Doom + Heavy Arbalest
Color identity: B | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 4 | Commander: legal
Produces: Destroy all creatures opponents control; Destroy all creatures opponents control whenever a creature enters the battlefield; Lock
Start: Thornbite Staff (battlefield); Gift of Doom (battlefield); Heavy Arbalest (battlefield)
Prerequisites: All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
  That creature does not have summoning sickness.
Steps: Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
  The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
  Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
  Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

## Combo 1870-3088-4873-5087
Cards: Darksteel Reactor + Eternity Vessel + Xenic Poltergeist + The Ozolith
Color identity: B | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Win the game
Start: Darksteel Reactor (battlefield); Eternity Vessel (battlefield); Xenic Poltergeist (battlefield: without summoning sickness); The Ozolith (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
  You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
Steps: Use Xenic Poltergeist to make Eternity Vessel a creature.
  Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
  The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
  At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
  Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

## Combo 1894-2173-2842-5220

Color identity: B | Bracket: 3+ (Powerful) | Popularity: 9 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite lifeloss; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite storm count
Start: Mortuary (battlefield); Bile Urchin (battlefield); Bolas's Citadel (battlefield); Blood Artist (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.

  Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
  Repeat.
